solution.description: Added score recalculation logic after clarification processing

key_changes.reason: Ensures scores are properly updated based on actual user input content

key_changes.description: New method that analyzes clarification answers and updates scores
features: Detects timeframe patterns and updates timeBound confidence to 0.8+
Detects measurable metrics and updates measurable confidence to 0.8+
Detects specific details and updates specific confidence to 0.8+
Updates confidence to at least 0.6 for any substantial answer (>20 chars)
Recalculates overall confidence as average of all criteria
Updates missingCriteria list based on new confidence scores

benefits: Scores now properly reflect user-provided information
Timeframe detection ensures timeline scores update when dates are mentioned
Metric detection ensures measurability scores update when numbers are provided
Specificity detection ensures detail scores update for comprehensive answers
Overall confidence accurately reflects completion status
Missing criteria list stays in sync with actual content
